name: Tōin (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tōin town emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by a stylised letter Y with horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Tōin, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1967.

features.role: Tōin town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a stylised letter Y with horizontal strokes
